verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an automatic mode that tries cheaper scrape configurations first and escalates only as needed. The 'reasoning' setting (firecrawl-gh-2) is a manual control, and the reliability and 'no proxy headaches' claim (firecrawl-gh-8) does not describe cost-based configuration selection. The axis applies to a paid scraping API, so the absence of evidence yields 'none'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the API automatically pick the cheapest configuration that still succeeds
